decision.reasoning_trace: I am evaluating backpacks for a serious multi-day hiking trip. My consideration set included the Maxpedition Prepared Citizen (prod_backpacks_038) and the QT&QY Military Tactical (prod_backpacks_057) due to their high ratings and durability. However, many of the items in the 'Backpacks' category were irrelevant accessories like stoves, food, and umbrellas. Furthermore, the tactical-style backpacks that dominated the high-quality options tend to be heavier than dedicated ultralight trekking packs. After reviewing the feedback on stitching and weight for the available models, I have decided not to make a purchase during this session as I require a more specialized technical hiking pack with a ventilated suspension system which is not represented here.
